zeroLiftAlpha.description: Angle of attack at zero lift.

dragConstant.description: Drag coefficient represented as a Vector3. No explicit default.

effectiveWingSpan.description: Effective wing span used for the wing model.

rollAccelDueToSideSlipAngle.description: Roll acceleration derivative with respect to sideslip angle.

rollAccelDueToRollRate.description: Roll acceleration derivative with respect to roll rate.

rollAccelDueToYawRate.description: Roll acceleration derivative with respect to yaw rate.

rollAccelDueToAileron.description: Roll acceleration derivative with respect to aileron input.

pitchAccelDueToAngleOfAttack.description: Pitch acceleration derivative with respect to angle of attack.

pitchAccelDueToPitchRate.description: Pitch acceleration derivative with respect to pitch rate.

pitchAccelDueToElevator.description: Pitch acceleration derivative with respect to elevator input.

yawAccelDueToSideSlipAngle.description: Yaw acceleration derivative with respect to sideslip angle.

yawAccelDueToRollRate.description: Yaw acceleration derivative with respect to roll rate.

yawAccelDueToYawRate.description: Yaw acceleration derivative with respect to yaw rate.

yawAccelDueToRudder.description: Yaw acceleration derivative with respect to rudder input.

hasControlSurfaces.description: Enables creation of stick, stick-trim, and rudder control inputs when a ControlInputsComponent is present.

positionRelBody.description: Rotor position relative to the body. (Required)

surfaceAreaPerBlade.description: Surface area of one rotor blade.

minCollectivePitch.description: Minimum collective pitch in degrees (converted to radians).

maxCollectivePitch.description: Maximum collective pitch in degrees (converted to radians).

maxTppPitch.description: Maximum tip-path-plane pitch in degrees (converted to radians).

maxTppRoll.description: Maximum tip-path-plane roll in degrees (converted to radians).

bladeStallAngleOfAttack.description: Blade stall angle of attack in degrees (converted to radians).

inducedVelocity.description: Induced velocity, represented as either a scalar or curve.

orientationRelBody.description: Optional rotor orientation relative to the body.

rpmMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the driver's RPM. (Required)

positionRelBody.description: Tail rotor position relative to the body. (Required)

orientationRelBody.description: Tail rotor orientation relative to the body. (Required)

minPitch.description: Minimum blade pitch in degrees (converted to radians).

maxPitch.description: Maximum blade pitch in degrees (converted to radians).

pitchResponseRate.description: Rate at which blade pitch responds to input.

ReactionControlSystemComponent.description: Reaction control system (RCS) model. Applies torque to a body directly in response to longitudional and laterial stick controlInputs, independently of body aerodynamics.

RocketMotorComponent.description: Simple motor model that applies thrust proportionally to throttle controlInput.

ShipWakeComponent.description: Defines geometric parameters for a ship wake.

type.description: Wake type. Supported values: shipWake, rotorWash. (Required)

bowWakeForwardOffset.description: Forward offset of the bow wake.

sternWakeForwardOffset.description: Forward offset of the stern wake.

spreadAngularWidth.description: Angular spread of the wake in degrees (converted to radians).

AttachmentPointsComponent.description: Defines a point to which another entity can be attached.

positionRelBody.description: Attachment-point position relative to the body. (Required)

name.description: Name used to register the attachment point. (Required)

orientationRelBody.description: Attachment-point orientation relative to the body.

AssetDescriptionComponent.description: Stores a human-readable description of an asset.

authors.description: JSON array of strings containing author names. (Required)

ScenarioMetadataComponent.description: Reads metadata for controlling entity behavior in the scenario.

scenarioObjectDirectory.description: String containing a /-separated directory of the object within the scenario.

userDeletable.description: Whether the scenario object can be deleted by the user.

persistAcrossLoad.description: Whether the object persists across scenario loads.

replicatable.description: Whether the object can be replicated over network.

tileSource.description: JSON object containing tile-source configuration. Must contain 'format' and 'maxLevel'. Can optionally contain 'heightMapTexelsOnTileEdge' (Default: false).

AttacherComponent.description: Attaches the entity to another entity.

CameraControllerComponent.description: Defines controllers for controlling the current camera state.

DynamicBodyComponent.description: Base class for dynamic bodies. See `SimpleDynamicBodyComponent` and `BulletDynamicBodyComponent` derived classes.

BulletDynamicBodyComponent.description: Six degree-of-freedom dynamic rigid body. Used instead of `SimpleDynamicBodyComponent` when `SkyboltBullet` plugin is available.

size.description: Vector3 defining dimensions of body in body axes. Only used by Bullet physics plugin. (Required)

KinematicBody.description: Kinematic body that can be externally moved and collide with other bodies, but does not simulate dynamics.

size.description: Vector3 defining dimensions of body in body axes. (Required)

jsbSimRootDir.description: Optional directory in which to search for JSBSim aircraft folders. If not set, JSBSim directory specified in Skybolt settings file will be used.
